name: New Trend International Logis-Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: New Trend International Logis-Tech Co.,Ltd. provides intralogistics solutions and smart intralogistics equipment in China and internationally. It offers NTI IIoT, an industrial internet platform; configurable Dev platform; IoT data platform; big data platform; and digital twin platform. The company also provides software product, such as warehouse logistics, smart logistics park, enterprise applications, and platform tools; Stacker Cranes lifting equipment for storing and retrieving goods unit; and automatic guided vehicle logistics equipment.
